== Biography ==
Anne was the daughter of [[Patterson-32385|David Patterson]], a miner and [[Montgomery-24104|Elizabeth Montgomery]] of Ballyculter, County Down. She was born on 26 Feb 1860 and baptised on 24 Jun 1860 in Ballyculter Church of Ireland.<ref>Church Baptism Record, Roots Ireland; https://www.rootsireland.ie/</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Annie Patterson. A reproduced Second Portglenone Presbyterian marriage list records John Elder, full-age bachelor of Rasharkin, marrying Annie Patterson, aged 20, on 12 May 1886. John's father is recorded as John Elder, farmer; Annie's father as David Patterson, farmer.<ref>Second Portglenone Presbyterian civil marriage 1886; [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1886/10833/5951328.pdf record].</ref> The identification remains uncertain.
